text: D3 ruling rule G14, for K01, written before its lines are ruled. K01 is shown when a concept shows the host room's own posting keyed as April Fools play: a fake post, a joke takeover of the room (its name, banner, style, rules or front page), parody run for the day, members naming the April Fools licence for what they post, or members doubting that a post, claim or call in the room is meant (it may be a joke). It is not shown by a concept that only explains r/place as Reddit's April Fools event, by jokes about the canvas or a neighbour's art with no play in the room's own posting, or by a call to the canvas taken at face value; those may show P12, P01 or other elements. Under G2 an absent line is rejected when its concepts show K01. K01 is a condition, not a universal claim, so absent lines are never corrections. Draws: one per 100-line instantiate packet by d3_sample_packet.py at the verb offsets its header confirms
